description: Core domain logic: Polly speech marks to captions conversion, VTT/SRT generation, audio duration measurement from PCM, and video manifest builder with timing resolution
steps: In packages/core/src/captions/, implement speech marks parser: parse Polly JSON lines format (one JSON object per line with time, type, start, end, value fields) into structured SpeechMark[] array

In packages/core/src/captions/, implement caption builder: group word-level speech marks into caption segments following rules from section 10.6 - max 20 chars per line, max 2 lines, min 1200ms display time, merge short segments, avoid splitting at particles (Japanese linguistic rules), highlight keyPoints words
In packages/core/src/captions/, implement captions.json generator: output array of {text, startMs, endMs, highlight[]} objects for the renderer
In packages/core/src/captions/, implement VTT generator: WebVTT format with proper timestamps (HH:MM:SS.mmm --> HH:MM:SS.mmm), sequential cue numbering
In packages/core/src/captions/, implement SRT generator: SubRip format with proper timestamps (HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm), sequential numbering

In packages/core/src/audio/, implement PCM duration measurement: calculate duration from PCM file size, sample rate (24000 from manifest voice config), and sample format (16-bit signed integers = 2 bytes per sample). Formula: durationMs = (fileSize / bytesPerSample) / sampleRate * 1000

In packages/core/src/manifest/, implement timing resolver: given array of slide data with measuredAudioMs, leadInMs (default 120), leadOutMs (default 400), calculate durationMs for each slide and cumulative startMs. Validate that no gaps or overlaps exist.
In packages/core/src/manifest/, implement manifest builder: construct full VideoManifest from slide generation results, audio results, and timing data. Populate all fields from section 9 schema.

Write comprehensive unit tests in packages/core/tests/: test captions with real Polly speech mark samples, test VTT/SRT format correctness, test PCM duration calculation with known file sizes, test timing resolver cumulative math, test edge cases (single slide, empty notes, max character boundaries)
acceptance_criteria: Speech marks parser correctly handles Polly JSON lines format
Caption builder respects 20-char line limit, 2-line max, 1200ms minimum duration
VTT output matches WebVTT specification format
SRT output matches SubRip specification format
PCM duration calculation: 24000 Hz, 16-bit = 48000 bytes/sec. A 288000 byte file = 6000ms
Timing resolver produces correct cumulative startMs values (slide N startMs = sum of all previous durationMs)
All unit tests pass with pnpm test
verification: Run pnpm test -- packages/core/tests/ and confirm all tests pass
Run pnpm build to confirm type-checking passes
